purpose: Authoritative execution-tier classification for every validation/ script, so 'used vs not used' is objective and maintainable. Tiers are evidence-based: traced by invocation in run_gate.py / release_check.py / create_gpt_runtime_upload_pack.py and cross-imports. Audited by validation/runtime_reachability_audit.py.

tiers.BUILD_GATE: Invoked by run_gate.py during every build validation; a build cannot PASS without it.
tiers.RUNTIME_LIB: Imported by build-runtime code (e.g. the resolver) rather than invoked standalone.
tiers.RELEASE_SELFTEST: Invoked by release_check.py (and/or the upload-pack builder) during release gating; validates the package, not an individual build.
tiers.AUDIT_TOOL: Advisory, run on demand (not gating). Measures the package.
tiers.REDUNDANT: Capability fully covered elsewhere (e.g. by a BUILD_GATE); scheduled for purge.

notes: NMS_NONUNIFORM_SCALE_SCANNER.py was classified REDUNDANT (its non-uniform-scale check is enforced by run_gate + PROHIBITED_AND_PLACEHOLDER_OBJECTS) and purged in 5.11.00. NMS_BUILD_USE_CASE_MINER.py is retained as an AUDIT_TOOL: it mines base-JSON exports to grow the single creative store (data/CREATIVE_USE_CASE_AND_STYLE_INDEX.json); it has no BUILD_GATE equivalent.
